unit: recallScoreUnit (packages/core/src/recall.ts): the bm25 weight of a word exactly one of a library's N indexed records carries, ln((N - 0.5) / 1.5), floored at 1e-6 as FTS5 floors a non-positive inverse document frequency. The threshold is counted in this unit and becomes the bm25 floor tau x unit in the library a prompt is put to (recallStrongHitFloor); a score below is divided by the unit of its own index.
method: The smallest whole number strictly above the best score, in that unit, any unrelated prompt reaches -- the recorded cross-project corpus's unrelated group (negative-queries.json) on the mixed index of this corpus (cards, minutes and work records, built as recall-inputs.ts builds them) and the small library's unrelated group (small-library.json) -- provided it is no higher than the lowest score a query of the small library's related group reaches for its own Story. Whole numbers, because retrieval.tau takes whole numbers. No margin beyond the step (TCRN-CROSS-MIN-164 D4). Recompute with node scripts/retrieval-eval.mjs --calibrate; the gate refuses a threshold the rule does not give on the corpus it names or a window the corpus no longer gives, and when no whole number separates the two groups it fails rather than pick one, because that trade-off belongs to the Owner (MIN-235 D9).
